description: Get Swiss monthly gross wage statistics from the Federal Statistical Office (FSO/BFS) Salary Structure Survey. Returns nationwide median (or other percentile) monthly wages in CHF for all industries and professional levels combined. Available for biennial survey years 2012–2024. Filter by gender (total/female/male) and percentile (median/P10/P25/P75/P90). Example: 2024 median wage overall ≈ CHF 6,502/month. Data: FSO Lohnstrukturerhebung, no auth.
name: swissfso.wages.monthly

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: Swiss Monthly Gross Wages
